rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a person viewed as oneself.

example.english: I want to be my own self again.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this for someone's personality, character, or usual manner rather than for the person as a reflexive self.

example.english: I think the self I show others is pretty easygoing.
example.traditional: 我覺得自己嘅性格幾易相處。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing3 gaak3 gei2 jik6 soeng1 cyu5

rows.note: Use this formal term for the inner psychological self that experiences thoughts and emotions.

example.english: Psychological research takes the feelings of the self seriously.
example.traditional: 心理學研究好重視自我嘅感受。
example.jyutping: sam1 lei5 hok6 jin4 gau3 hou2 cung5 si6 zi6 ngo5 ge3 gam2 sau6

rows.note: Use this when self-interest means a selfish motive or personal agenda, not merely a neutral personal benefit.

example.english: I’m not acting to benefit my own self; I genuinely want to help the team.
example.traditional: 我唔係出於私心，真係想幫個團隊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 ceot1 jyu1 si1 sam1 zan1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 go3 tyun4 deoi6
